#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
source /workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/build.env
cd /workspace/Nexora-delivery-773
out=/workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/authoring/strict-player
trap 'printf "%s\n" "$?" > "$out/all-gates.exit"' EXIT
run_gate() {
  local label="$1"
  shift
  printf '%s\n' "$label" > "$out/current-gate"
  local result=0
  "$@" > "$out/$label.log" 2>&1 || result=$?
  printf '%s\n' "$result" > "$out/$label.exit"
  return "$result"
}
run_gate development-configure cmake --preset linux-development -DNEXORA_BUILD_SHOWCASE=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_EDITOR_GRAPHICAL_SHELL=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_SLANG=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_ZIG_GAMEPLAY=ON -DNEXORA_ZIG_EXECUTABLE=/workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/tools/lib/python3.12/site-packages/ziglang/zig -DNEXORA_BUILD_PROJECT_PLAYER=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLAYER_NATIVE=ON
run_gate development-build cmake --build --preset linux-development
run_gate development-gcc15 python3 "$out/compile-gcc15.py" build/linux-development development
run_gate development-test ctest --preset linux-development --output-on-failure
run_gate shipping-configure cmake --preset linux-shipping -DNEXORA_SHIPPING_PROFILE=Full -DNEXORA_BUILD_SHOWCASE=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_2D=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_EDITOR_SDK=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_SLANG=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_ZIG_GAMEPLAY=ON -DNEXORA_ZIG_EXECUTABLE=/workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/tools/lib/python3.12/site-packages/ziglang/zig -DNEXORA_BUILD_PROJECT_PLAYER=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLAYER_NATIVE=ON
run_gate shipping-build cmake --build --preset linux-shipping
run_gate shipping-source-native python3 Tests/TwoD/SpriteSourcePlayerAcceptance.py --app /workspace/Nexora-delivery-773/build/linux-shipping/Apps/TwoDPlayer/NexoraTwoDPlayer --zig /workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/tools/lib/python3.12/site-packages/ziglang/zig --cmake /workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/tools/lib/python3.12/site-packages/cmake/data/bin/cmake --compiler /workspace/Nexora-delivery-773/build/linux-development/Tools/TwoD/NexoraTwoDAssetCompiler --catalog --animation --native --shipping --evidence-dir /workspace/Nexora-delivery-773/build/linux-shipping/artifacts/strict-source-animation-player
run_gate shipping-sample-reload python3 Tests/TwoD/ZigNativeAcceptance.py --app /workspace/Nexora-delivery-773/build/linux-shipping/Gameplay/Zig/NexoraZigTwoD --evidence-dir /workspace/Nexora-delivery-773/build/linux-shipping/artifacts/strict-sample-reload
run_gate monolithic-configure cmake --preset linux-development -B build/source-reload-monolithic -DNEXORA_LINK_MODE=Monolithic -DNEXORA_ENABLE_2D=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_EDITOR_GRAPHICAL_SHELL=ON -DNEXORA_ENABLE_SLANG=OFF -DNEXORA_ENABLE_ZIG_GAMEPLAY=ON -DNEXORA_ZIG_EXECUTABLE=/workspace/work/engine-goal-20261112/tools/lib/python3.12/site-packages/ziglang/zig
run_gate monolithic-build cmake --build build/source-reload-monolithic --target NexoraGameplayGenerationTests NexoraSourceReloadTests NexoraTwoDPlayerGenerationTests NexoraTwoDAuthoringTests NexoraTwoDPanelTests NexoraTwoDPlayer
run_gate monolithic-gcc15 python3 "$out/compile-gcc15.py" build/source-reload-monolithic monolithic
run_gate monolithic-test ctest --test-dir build/source-reload-monolithic -R '^twod\.(gameplay_generation|source_reload_transaction|player_reload_generations|authoring_contracts|graphical_controls)$' --output-on-failure
